data.long_meaning: One who embarks on a journey or expedition. data.cultural_impact: The name 'Faraatoon' holds significant cultural importance in the Islamic tradition, as it is reminiscent of the Prophet Muhammad's migration from Mecca to Medina, also known as the Hijrah. This journey was a pivotal moment in Islamic history, as it marked the beginning of the Islamic community and the establishment of the first Muslim state. Thus, the name 'Faraatoon' can be seen as a symbol of courage, faith, and determination in overcoming challenges and committing to new beginnings.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name 'Faraatoon' can be interpreted as a reminder of the journey of life and the importance of remaining steadfast in one's faith and commitment to Allah. Just as the Prophet Muhammad embarked on a physical journey to a new home, we too are on a spiritual journey towards the Afterlife. The name 'Faraatoon' encourages us to keep moving forward, regardless of the challenges we may face, and to continually strive towards drawing closer to Allah SWT.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Traveler, Wanderer" symbolizes One who embarks on a journey or expedition. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Faraatoon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of traveler, wanderer.

historical_references.reference: Faraatoon is mentioned in the book 'Al-Amaali' by Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha as a title of one of his companions.
